excerpt: Rubrik sells data backup, cyber recovery and data security software and is listed on the NYSE as RBRK. What it does, its founders, its 2024 IPO and the main alternatives.
content:
Rubrik makes data security software. Its core job is backing up an organisation's data across data centres, public clouds and SaaS apps in a form attackers cannot encrypt or delete, then helping the organisation recover quickly after a ransomware attack or other incident. Its platform, Rubrik Security Cloud, also monitors that data for threats and sensitive information, covers identity systems, and now pitches tools to govern and roll back the actions of AI agents.

The company was founded in 2014 in Palo Alto by Bipul Sinha, Arvind Jain, Soham Mazumdar and Arvind Nithrakashyap. Sinha, a former partner at Lightspeed Venture Partners, is chief executive, and Nithrakashyap, who earlier co-founded Oracle's Exadata storage platform, is chief technology officer. Jain left in 2019 and went on to found the AI search company Glean.

Rubrik went public on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker RBRK. It priced its upsized initial public offering at $32 a share, above its expected range, selling 23.5 million Class A shares, and trading began on 25 April 2024. As a listed company it reports its results publicly every quarter.

Rubrik sells mainly to mid-sized and large organisations; its website says more than 6,000 organisations use it. We found no public price list on Rubrik's site. Buyers request a demo and get a quote, so we do not give a starting price here.

We have not used Rubrik for this page. It brings together Rubrik's own website and pricing page and reporting from the outlets linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from.

faq.a: It backs up organisations' data in a form attackers cannot change and helps them recover quickly after cyberattacks, while monitoring that data for threats and sensitive information.
